methods.name: task_offer
methods.description: [no-quorum] answers a signed tape.agent/offer with a signed tape.agent/accept announcing a fresh agentKey for this order (every answer is signed at its own time)

methods.name: task_mandate
methods.description: [no-quorum] hands over the holder-signed mandate; the work starts only if it verifies (phase 0: enforcement none, every cap 0)

methods.name: task_deliver
methods.description: [no-quorum] the signed tape.agent/deliver: deliverableHash, hash-only receipts of every upstream call, receiptsHash

methods.name: task_status
methods.description: [no-quorum] where an order stands; with the signed mandate it also returns the deliverable, with a signed revocation message it stops the order

tasks.description: Reads the BNB Smart Chain block height from the providers a mandate lists, and answers with every answer it got.
